name: aws-ops-plugin
description: AWS/EKS infrastructure operations and troubleshooting plugin — EKS cluster management, networking, IAM, observability, storage, database, and cost optimization

hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_OUTPUT" | grep -qiE "Access[ -]?Denied|Permission denied|not authorized to perform|Unauthorized|Forbidden|ThrottlingException|Throttled|TooManyRequests|SlowDown|LimitExceeded|AuthFailure|SignatureDoesNotMatch|ExpiredToken|Validation(Error|Exception)|NotFound|ServiceUnavailable|InternalServer|FailureReason|An error occurred"; then echo "AWS error pattern detected in output. Consider capturing for incident context."; fi'
echo 'AWS Ops Plugin loaded. Domains: EKS, Network, IAM, Observability, Storage, Database, Analytics, Cost, Well-Architected.'
